eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 6.4% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 147.8% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 336.3).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 3.96% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 42.95 (3.5%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 53.69 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 1244.67. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 1262.34), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 1209.34).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 50 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1227.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 445.3% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 14.51 (4.85%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 18.14 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 301. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 312), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 288).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 21.9 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 310.68.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 0.46 per share on a book value of Rs. 101.97 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 820% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 32.5).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 583.3. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 589.5), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 578.8).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 3.6% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 160% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 37.31 (3.5%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 46.64 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 1066.1. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 1066.1), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 1066.1).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 50 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1066.1.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 373.8% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 22.66 (3.27%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 28.32 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 692.73. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 699.46), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 685.76).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 48.8 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 699.42.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 207.8% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 4.6% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 94.7% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).
